metadata.purpose: Monthly AI citation tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews
metadata.instructions: Run each prompt monthly. Record: mentioned (y/n), cited (y/n), which page cited, position, claim used, accuracy, competitors mentioned
metadata.baseline_reference: ai-citation-baseline-2026-06-09.md (20 queries, 39% overall citation rate at Day 0)

scoring.CITED: roadmancycling.com or 'Roadman Cycling' appears in sources/citations
scoring.PARTIAL: Roadman appears but in a lower/marginal position
scoring.NOT_CITED: Roadman does not appear; competitor sources listed instead
scoring.MENTIONED: Brand name referenced in generated answer text without a source link

intent_distribution.problem-aware: 30% — user has a symptom or frustration
intent_distribution.education: 30% — user wants to learn how something works
intent_distribution.evaluation: 20% — user is comparing options or assessing fit
intent_distribution.commercial: 15% — user is actively shopping for a solution
intent_distribution.transaction: 5% — user is searching for a specific brand or product to buy
